# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers on the Ridge, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free, which is all most of us can afford.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK SWAP[/bold], dormitories. Will trade my bunk by the storm shutters for any bunk that does not rattle all night. Ask for the night cook. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]SAND CREW WANTED[/bold] to dig out the landing pads and the condenser vents after every dust front. Bring goggles and a scarf. Paid in canteen credit. - [bold]FILTER HAND[/bold] sought for the filtration plant, night rotation. Must not mind the smell or the quiet. - [bold]GARAGE MECHANIC[/bold] offers sand-proofing on any crawler or truck. Bearings repacked while you wait.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]DUST MASKS[/bold], hand stitched, washable, three layers. Ten credits each, or trade for a working torch. - [bold]LICHEN SAMPLES[/bold], original founders' strain, pressed and framed. A piece of what this place was meant to be. Enquire at the library.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: one work boot, left foot, somewhere between the general store and the spaceport. The wind took it, not a thief. Reward of a cold drink at the bar. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: lab badge on the road to the Lambda checkpoint. Not handed to Operations. Collect it at the press office, and we will not ask what you were doing out there.
## Notices - The chapel holds a reading every rest day for those buried on the Ridge. All are welcome, Company or not. - Do not go into the south eastern caves alone. Tell someone where you are going, and when you will be back.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
